$generated.description: A marketing top navigation bar: a required brand { name:{it,en}, optional brandIcon name-token from an owned enum resolved internally } + optional links[] (each { label:{it,en}, href }) + a required primaryCta and an optional secondaryCta (each { label:{it,en}, href }); all text is {it,en}. It is a sticky top bar (named z step, hairline, solid surface) with a two-view: the wide view shows the links INLINE in the bar with the CTAs to the right, the narrow view hides the inline links behind a hamburger button that opens a Radix Dialog drawer holding the stacked links + both CTAs. No prop carries raw code.

a11y: The narrow-view disclosure is a real, keyboard-operable control: the hamburger is a native <button> with an accessible name resolved from {it,en} (aria-label "Apri menu"/"Open menu"), wrapped in Radix Dialog.Trigger so it exposes aria-expanded (false while closed, true while open) and aria-controls its drawer; it is reachable by Tab and activated by Enter/Space, and carries a visible focus-visible ring (ring-ring offset from the background) legible on the sticky surface in both themes.

The drawer is a compliant modal built on Radix Dialog.Content: it is CLOSED by default, opens with role=dialog + aria-modal=true, traps focus (Tab/Shift+Tab cycle only its links, both CTAs, and the labelled close control), closes on Escape or scrim click, and RESTORES focus to the hamburger trigger on close; it carries a Dialog.Title and an sr-only Dialog.Description so the dialog is named to assistive tech without a duplicate visible heading.

Every declared link and CTA is a real anchor (<a href>), keyboard-operable and reachable by Tab in DOM order, activating on Enter and navigating to its declared href, each with the same visible focus-visible ring; the primary/secondary CTA distinction and the active/hover link affordance are carried by fill and outline and label and underline, never by colour alone, so they stay distinguishable to a colour-blind or monochrome viewer.

One nav landmark (a single <nav>) hosts the bar; the sticky surface is the AA-verified solid bg-background / text-foreground pairing (a solid surface fallback rather than a translucent blur so text and non-text contrast stay AA ON the bar), links use foreground/muted-foreground and the accent-driven --accent-ink hover, and the accent band on the primary CTA is the AA bg-primary / text-primary-foreground pairing, so axe A/AA is clean in BOTH themes on the bar AND inside the open drawer. Only the container-width branch in layout is announced: the inline links are display:none at narrow and the hamburger is display:none at wide, never double-counted.
forbidden: No raw HTML/code or SVG string in any prop and no dangerouslySetInnerHTML: every text field (brand name, each link label, each CTA label) is an {it,en} plain string, each link/CTA is exactly { label:{it,en}, href }, so a declaration can never inject markup, a script, or an icon/graphic as a code or ReactNode slot.

The brand icon is a name-token only: brandIcon is the owned iconNameSchema enum resolved internally to a lucide component, and a brandIcon given as a raw SVG/HTML string or an arbitrary name outside the enum is a contract error (InvalidComponentPropsError), never a rendered graphic; there is no other prop through which a declaration supplies its own icon or graphic.

No hardcoded hue or hex/oklch/hsl literal and no arbitrary z or spacing/radius bracket: colour comes only from the accent-driven and semantic tokens (bg-background / text-foreground / text-muted-foreground / border-border / bg-primary / text-primary-foreground / --accent-ink / ring-ring), the sticky/overlay/content stacking comes only from the named z ladder (--z-sticky / --z-scrim / --z-modal), and spacing/radius use only named scale steps (h-*/px-*/py-*/gap-*/rounded-*), never a fixed value or a [13px]-style bracket.

No dropdown/mega-menu sub-navigation and no forced-open drawer prop: the two-view is a container-query structural change (inline links vs a hamburger disclosure), the narrow drawer's open/closed state is internal Radix Dialog state, and there is no prop that supplies nested menus, collapse markup, or forces the drawer open.
